facts: Followed InSight to Mars in loose formation
Provided a real-time link to Earth during InSight entry, descent and landing on 2018-11-26
Deployable X-band reflectarray high-gain antennas and full-duplex UHF/X-band radios
Micro CubeSat propulsion system with eight thrusters, 755 N-s total impulse, 3.49 kg wet mass
